steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each band is placed by its source and its spread against the client's stated range.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Band with no source
findings.fix: Cite the source of the band

findings.title: Spread outside the client's stated range
findings.fix: Adjust the spread to the range

outcome.notChecked: Whether the structure is lawful in each jurisdiction.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] band-grade-b.md:12  Band with no source.
       Fix: Cite the source of the band.
[medium] progression.md:19  Spread outside the client's stated range.
       Fix: Adjust the spread to the range.
[low] market-source.md:26  Progression rule with no basis.
       Fix: State the basis.
Not checked: Whether the structure is lawful in each jurisdiction.
pros: Checks a band with no source, a spread outside the client's stated range, and a progression rule with no basis.
cons: Not checked: Whether the structure is lawful in each jurisdiction.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-pay-structure-design skill on the records for this review.
